title: Senior Accountant (Female for Gender Balance) Job at the Vault Recruitment
content:
The Vault Recruitment (TVR)  - Our client, a reputable pharmacy, is recruiting suitable candidates to fill the position below:

Job Position: Senior Accountant (Female for Gender Balance)


Vacancy Code: FMP001
Job Location: Ajah-Sangotedo axis, Lagos
Employment Type: Full time
Industry: Pharmacy



Job Summary


	We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Chartered Accountant to manage the organization’s financial records, ensure compliance with financial regulations, and provide strategic financial insights to support business decisions.
	The ideal candidate must possess strong analytical skills, excellent knowledge of accounting standards, and experience in financial reporting and tax compliance.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports.
	Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger activities.
	Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
	Ensure compliance with statutory regulations, tax requirements, and financial policies.
	Conduct financial analysis and provide recommendations for cost control and financial efficiency.
	Coordinate external audits and liaise with auditors when required.
	Manage payroll processing and statutory remittances.
	Monitor budgets and track financial performance against targets.
	Ensure proper documentation and filing of financial transactions.


Requirements


	Must have started ICAN (ICAN / ACCA certified).
	Minimum of 2–3 years of relevant accounting experience (pharmacy, retail, or FMCG experience is an advantage).
	Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
	Experience with financial analysis and budgeting.
	Knowledge of Nigerian tax laws and statutory compliance.
	Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting standards.
	Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
	Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
	High level of integrity and attention to detail.

The company focuses on combining technology, creativity, and strategic communication to help businesses build strong brand identities, enhance their online presence, and effectively reach their target audience. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Location: Lagos Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Electric Vehicles (EV) / Automotive

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a dynamic, target-driven and commercially minded Corporate Sales Executive to drive the sale of Electric Vehicles (EVs) to corporate organizations, government institutions, SMEs, fleet operators and other business clients.
	The ideal candidate should be a highly driven B2B sales professional who can open doors, build relationships with corporate decision-makers and convert opportunities into revenue. The candidate must be comfortable with cold prospecting, networking, presentations, negotiations and working in a target-driven environment


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and develop new corporate sales opportunities for the company's EV products.
	Prospect and engage companies, government agencies, NGOs, fleet operators and other institutional clients.
	Develop and maintain a strong corporate client database and sales pipeline.
	Conduct presentations and product demonstrations to prospective corporate clients.
	Understand clients' mobility and fleet requirements and recommend suitable EV solutions.
	Prepare and submit quotations, proposals and sales presentations.
	Negotiate commercial terms and close sales in line with company policies.
	Build and maintain long-term relationships with key corporate decision-makers.
	Follow up consistently on leads, proposals and pending deals.
	Work closely with the Marketing, Operations, Finance and Technical teams to ensure smooth customer on-boarding and vehicle delivery.
	Monitor competitors, market trends, pricing and developments within the EV industry.
	Participate in corporate events, exhibitions, networking sessions and industry engagements to generate leads.
	Develop strategies to achieve and exceed assigned sales targets.
	Maintain accurate records of prospects, customer interactions, opportunities and sales activities.
	Prepare regular sales reports and provide updates on the sales pipeline to management.
	Gather customer feedback and communicate market intelligence to management.
	Ensure excellent customer experience throughout the sales process and after-sales engagement.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Achievement of monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
	Number and value of corporate accounts acquired.
	Lead generation and conversion rate.
	Sales revenue generated.
	Number of new corporate partnerships established.
	Sales pipeline value and growth.
	Customer retention and repeat business.
	Average sales conversion cycle.
	Quality and accuracy of sales reporting.
	Customer satisfaction levels.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree/HND in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Economics or a related field.
	5-8 years of experience in corporate/B2B sales preferably in the automotive, mobility, technology, energy or related industry.
	Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
	Strong business development and relationship management skills.
	Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
	Ability to engage and influence senior-level corporate decision-makers.
	Good understanding of the Nigerian corporate market.
	Strong prospecting, follow-up and closing skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM/sales management tools.
	Must be self-motivated, commercially driven and comfortable working with sales targets.
	Knowledge or interest in electric vehicles, renewable energy or sustainable mobility will be an added advantage.
	A valid driver's licence and willingness to travel for business meetings will be an advantage.

N2,000,000 monthly Gross + Commission/Incentives

title: Quality Control Technician Job at Future Moves Recruitment Agency
content:
Future Moves Recruitment Agency is a licensed full-fledged Human Resource firm with extensive expertise and experience in human Capital development and staffing. Future Moves has exceptional expertise in Talent Sourcing, learning & development, talent management, HR Outsourcing & Payrolling, HR planning & Consulting, Policy Drafting, Culture Change and Organisation Effectiveness by designing and implementing interventions which identify the core areas of development to enhance the overall growth and competitiveness of your organization.
     

            
    



At FMR Agency we have unique and creative solutions that meet the clients expectations not only by realizing the clients business objectives, but particularly by our strict adherence to the ethical principles of public relations, we always search for opportunities beyond the agreed communications and the business objectives, we address special needs in other to find unique and tailored solutions through creative approaches.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Quality Control Technician

Job Location: Idu, Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type:

About the Role


	FMR Agency is recruiting a detail-oriented QC Technician to join the Quality Control team of a leading construction materials company.
	The successful candidate will conduct laboratory and field tests on concrete and construction materials, maintain accurate testing records, and ensure materials meet required quality specifications.


Key Responsibilities


	Conduct concrete slump tests to verify workability and compliance with approved mix designs.
	Prepare, label, cure, and maintain concrete cube samples for compressive strength testing.
	Perform compressive strength tests on concrete cubes and accurately record results.
	Conduct aggregate sieve analysis and other material tests.
	Determine aggregate moisture content and communicate results to the batching plant team for mix adjustments.
	Maintain accurate laboratory and field testing records, including test reports, cube registers, and quality logs.
	Monitor and maintain curing tanks, testing equipment, and laboratory facilities.
	Report failed tests, quality concerns, and material non-conformities promptly.
	Ensure laboratory activities comply with company quality procedures, testing standards, and HSE requirements.
	Assist in investigating quality issues and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
	Monitor laboratory consumables and report shortages or equipment maintenance needs.
	Perform other quality control duties assigned by Management.


Qualifications & Experience


	ND, HND, or Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Building Technology, Materials Engineering, or a related field.
	3–5 years of experience in concrete quality control, laboratory testing, or construction materials testing.
	Experience in a ready-mix concrete or construction materials laboratory is an added advantage.


Salary
N150,000 / Month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using "Quality Control & Laboratory" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
